newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 14,400 MT were 31 percent below the week earlier and 35 percent under the 4-week average. Mexico (2,900 MT, of which 2,600 MT was rough), Haiti (2,800 MT), Canada (2,600 MT), Saudi Arabia (1,800 MT), and the Netherlands (1,300 MT) were the primary buyers.

Exports of 16,900 MT were 80 percent below the previous week and 62 percent below the 4-week average. The major destinations were the Netherlands (5,900 MT), Mexico (3,700 MT), Belgium (1,300 MT), Switzerland (1,300 MT), and Saudi Arabia (1,300 MT).
